summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long DOCN Daily Target ETF (OCNL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the DigitalOcean Holdings stock (NYSE: DOCN), less fees, and expenses. DOCN engages in the provision of cloud infrastructure. OCNL was launched on Aug 6, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
